season.evidence: Stored June; searched Teanaway/De Roux pages: spring snow in June, dry from July. No track names or follows the East Gully.

otherTracksConsidered.why: June 14 loop from De Roux over several peaks, descended from the East Peak; not shown to climb the east gully

facts.text: In mid-June a trail marked on maps below the East Peak could not be found, so expect to descend off-trail to the De Roux path.
Helmets were worn along the Esmeralda summit traverse in mid-June.

season.evidence: Searched Mountaineers/summitpost pages: snow scramble possible early June, dry class 2 July-early Oct, avoid very hot days; stored mid-July to October.

track.why: No logged route name or report; but track is a round trip from De Roux (start 6 m, end 28 m from our pin), passes within 11 m of our last-switchback pin, tops the west summit within 5 m and returns the same way, matching our route text. East Gully is on the East Peak from another trailhead. Date is Nov 23, about 3 weeks after season end (borderline, owner may drop).
